en.headline: Science Park launches first co-create co-invest summit and fund investments
en.dek: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation opened a six-day event linking founders, investors and industry, and announced the first investments from its HK$500 million co-acceleration fund.
body: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation began its first Co-Development and Investment Conference on Monday, a six-day programme spanning Hong Kong, Dongguan and Hangzhou that brings together start-up founders, investors and industry leaders.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan opened the event at the Science Park, saying Hong Kong is a rapidly rising innovation hub that complements the strengths of Greater Bay Area cities. The corporation’s chairman, Fanny Cheung, described the gathering as an efficient commercialisation engine that connects the three sides of the ecosystem.

The corporation also announced the first investments from its HK$500 million Co-Acceleration Fund, a public-private partnership managed by a Science Park subsidiary. The initial batch supports four high-potential deep-tech companies in areas including hydrogen energy, Internet-of-Things sensing and AI-driven robotics. The fund currently has nine limited partners.

zh.headline: 科技園首辦共創共投峰會 公布5億元基金首批投資
zh.dek: 香港科技園公司一連六日舉辦共創共投產業加速峰會，並公布共同企業加速基金首批四個投資項目，涵蓋氫能、物聯網及人工智能機械人等。
body: 香港科技園公司周一展開首屆「共創共投產業加速峰會」，一連六日在香港、東莞及杭州舉行，匯聚創科始創人、投資者及產業領袖。
財政司司長陳茂波在科學園主持開幕禮，指香港是快速崛起的創新高地，可與大灣區城市優勢互補。科技園公司主席鍾郝儀表示，峰會將三方生態圈集中於同一平台，形成高效商業化引擎。
公司同日公布資產規模達5億港元的「共同企業加速基金」首批投資項目，支援四間高潛力深科技企業，範疇包括氫能、自主供電物聯網檢測技術及人工智能驅動機械人等。基金現有九個有限合夥人，屬科技園管理的公私營協作計劃。
